summary: End-to-end verification of the new per-client NOTES (bitácora) feature and the relocation of the unified Smart-Card lead card from above-the-tabs into the Info tab. Backend (pytest, 8/8 PASS) covers GET/POST/DELETE /api/clients/{id}/notes: empty list initially, create returns the persisted shape (id/client_id/text/created_at, NO _id), empty/whitespace text -> 400, list is sorted newest-first (verified across 3 sequential POSTs with timestamps), delete removes the note and returns ok:true, unknown note_id -> 404, unknown client_id -> 404 on both GET and POST, and missing auth -> 401/403. Frontend (Playwright, all 13 steps PASS): logged in as pzsuave007 then opened a freshly seeded Smart-Card lead client; (1) data-testid='client-lead-card' is rendered INSIDE a [role=tabpanel] (the Info tab) and is NOT present above the tabs; (2) tab order is exactly Info(0), Notas(1), Cotizaciones(2), Contratos(3), Facturas(4), Mensajes(5), Fotos(6) — history-tab-notas is the SECOND tab as required; (3) empty state 'Aún no hay notas' shown before any note exists; (4) typed text into note-input and clicked note-add-btn — a note-card-<id> appears with a localized timestamp; (5) added a second note and verified the newest one renders ABOVE the older one (text order: 'Segunda nota mas nueva.' first, 'Primera nota: llame al cliente.' second); (6) deleted the newest via note-delete-<id>, the card disappears and count drops by 1; (7) clicking a note card opens the bottom drawer titled '¿Qué quieres hacer con esta nota?' showing all three rows (note-action-quote / note-action-invoice / note-action-message); (8) note-action-quote navigates to /quotes/nuevo?client_id=<cid>&ai=1 with quote-prefill-note visible and quote-ai-description PRE-FILLED with the note's text ('Primera nota: llame al cliente.'); (9) note-action-invoice navigates to /invoices/nuevo?client_id=<cid>; (10) note-action-message navigates to /mensajes?client_id=<cid>; (11) lead card details inside Info tab still correct (badge 'Quiere conectar', client-lead-contact-btn href starts with 'https://wa.me/5550009999'). Regression: the 'Crear' bottom drawer still works (all 5 rows drawer-action-quote-ai/invoice/contract/message/scope visible) and the Cotizaciones/Contratos/Facturas/Mensajes/Fotos tabs all switch without errors. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/clients/{id}/notes correctly validates empty/whitespace text (400) and is owner-scoped via get_current_user_id; list query excludes _id with projection {'_id':0} — clean.

Sort uses created_at descending (server.py:4164) and _now_iso() resolution is to the second; if two notes are inserted in the same second the order is undefined. Acceptable in practice (the UI gives a 1-sec gap when humans type) but consider switching to a monotonic field or using inserted_id sort as a tiebreaker.

ClientDetail.js correctly moved leadCard inside TabsContent value='info' (line 355) and removed it from above the tabs — verified that the DOM element [data-testid=client-lead-card] now has a [role=tabpanel] ancestor.
noteAction() passes prefillDescription via location.state to /quotes/nuevo?ai=1 — verified end-to-end that QuoteBuilder reads it and populates quote-ai-description.
Notes don't currently support edit, only add/delete. Not requested but worth noting for parity with the editable client-level 'notes' field in the Info card.
No pagination or limit on the UI — backend caps at 500 (to_list(500)), reasonable for the foreseeable future.
